name: Create Spelljamming Helm
materials: a crystal rod worth at least 5000 gp, which the spell consumes
description_json: Holding the rod used in the casting of the spell, you touch a Large or smaller chair that is unoccupied. The rod disappears, and the chair is transformed into a Spelljamming Helm.
